current_hypothesis: A local outgoing-branch representation inferred from LiDAR can causally construct a compact topometric graph, but useful generalization must be established on unseen procedural topology before training or planner integration claims.

current_question: When the development-world LiDAR rule and online-graph parameters are frozen, do they retain usable branch, node and geometric-edge accuracy across five newly generated Cano topologies without retuning?
